correctness.rationale: For bosonic Davies qubit GKSL reset at fixed s=r/gamma>0, x=e^(beta omega)-1, exact stationary Bloch coordinates are z=(sa-1)x/(2+(1+s)x) and w=s w_delta x/(1+(s+1/2+i kappa)x). Their beta derivatives and the full-rank qubit SLD QFI metric yield a smooth uniformly bounded rational objective on the entire compact reset Bloch ball as x->0. Leading QFI/omega^2=(sa-1)^2/4+s^2 t; derivative in transverse squared amplitude t is s^2+O(x)>0, forcing pure reset targets. Along t=1-a^2, leading f_s(a)=s^2+1/4 -sa/2-3s^2 a^2/4 is strictly concave, maximized at a=-1 for s<=1/3 and a=-1/(3s) for s>1/3. Uniform second derivative and boundary sign extend exact optimal types to sufficiently small positive beta omega; the derivative at a=-1 equals s(3s-1)/2+x s^2(1-7s)+O(x^2), so IFT gives critical curve s_c=1/3+8x/27+O(x^2). Exact rational evaluation at x=1/5,s=2,kappa=1,a=-1/2,t=3/4 gives coherent QFI 11574741702400/8063279547193 versus largest diagonal 405/338. This is an inverse-temperature QFI and specified ordered limits, not all temperatures.
